title: TrainingSet
description: The manifest of one TrainingExample stream (ADR-009 §4): which Episodes it was built from, which EvaluationRunManifests were checked against them, and the stream's class and digest. The sorted and unique arrays are enforced by the reader (the contract profile has no uniqueItems).

data_class.description: The highest class of the Episodes in the stream; a stream with any private Episode is private and is never committed (ADR-008 §5).

episode_hashes.description: The accepted Episodes' hashes (episodeHash), sorted and unique.

evaluation_manifest_hashes.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of each EvaluationRunManifest checked against those Episodes, sorted and unique; may be empty.

examples.description: The number of lines in the stream.

stream_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stream's bytes: its JCS lines, each ended by a newline.

learner_ready.description: true when every example of the stream carries candidates and outcome, and choice is among its candidates. The profile has no if/then, so the reader checks it (readTrainingSet; the Python stream check); the learner refuses a set without the flag (ADR-010 §5). Requires behaviour_policy_id.

behaviour_policy_id.description: The loader's behaviour_policy_id filter value: the one policy whose own seats this stream trains (ADR-010 §1). Every Episode in it has that policy as its provenance.behaviour_policy_id.
